section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the evolution of body image research and the development of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version (BAS-2). The text discusses BAS-2 validation across multiple countries and cultural contexts, highlighting its psychometric properties including one-dimensional factor structure, high internal consistency, and temporal stability. The section identifies gaps in the literature, particularly the lack of BAS-2 validation in adolescent populations and the absence of evidence for measurement invariance across weight status. The study aims to examine the psychometric properties of BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents, with hypotheses including factorial validity, invariance across gender and weight status, positive correlation with life satisfaction, and negative correlation with social physique anxiety and BMI.
